Troubleshooting: Observe whether the power indicator is steadily on. If it is on, check the LED color. An orange LED indicates that the AC source is connected but the equipment is not started, and a blue LED indicates that the equipment is started. If it is off, check whether the AC source is connected, whether the fuse is intact, and whether the power cable is connected normally without looseness, disconnection, or instability.
Check whether the camera head and CCU are connected normally without looseness or instability, whether the CCU and monitor are connected normally, and whether the monitor input settings are correct.
Check whether the CCU and monitor are connected firmly.

Check whether the image processing host is placed horizontally, and whether any objects have been placed on the host. If something unusual suddenly occurs, please turn off the power supply and contact the maintenance staff.
Verify that the DVI cable is properly connected. If the problem persists, contact the maintenance staff.
Check the HEAD connect the HOST, re-connect the HOST. If it can’t be solved, please contact service.
